_comment: X API v2 pay-per-use watch. Prices as documented by the previous builder on 24 Oct 2026: VERIFY against the X developer console and adjust here (`fart social calibrate --day D --console-usd N` says which price fits a day's console amount). All intervals in seconds, all money in USD. Milestone 7: the confirmation layer is a cost-aware planner (`planner` below, fart/social/planner.py, fart/social/xbudget.py); the account watches run slower outside the peak hours. Not a rule file (fart/version.py RULE_FILES): changing a value here never changes the rules fingerprint.

prices._comment: search_recent: per post returned, deduplicated per UTC day. counts_recent: per request. author_expansion: per user per UTC day, for the `expansions=author_id` user objects of the mega/KOL searches AND for the `GET /2/users?ids=` lookup of at most planner.search_max_authors authors after a confirmation search (assumed the same per-user price: VERIFY). refresh (GET /2/tweets?ids=) assumed free for same-day re-reads: VERIFY.

envelope._comment: Hourly pacing of the daily cap. Hours (UTC) in peak_hours get weight peak_weight, the rest off_weight; a call is admitted when today's spend plus its expected cost stays under cap x cumulative weight through the current hour, otherwise it is DEFERRED to a later hour (milestone 7: never refused, never ledgered as blocked; counted in kv x.planner.deferred.<kind>.<day>). The hard rules stay refusals for the rest of the UTC day: the cap itself (checked against the ceiling cost of the call, so the cap can never be exceeded), account_watch_reserve_fraction of the cap reserved for the mega + KOL watches (confirmation calls may use at most 1 - reserve), and the KOL sub-cap. The peak hours also set the mega/KOL intervals (interval_peak_s / interval_off_s).

mega.query: (from:elonmusk OR ((from:realDonaldTrump OR from:WhiteHouse OR from:POTUS OR from:cz_binance OR from:MrBeast OR from:justinsuntron OR from:saylor OR from:VitalikButerin) -is:reply)) -is:retweet

confirm._comment: The confirmation keys and their one search (the schedule and the stop rules are in `planner`). Only unambiguous keys: the mint itself, $TICKER (>= min_ticker_len, not generic) and the exact coin name when it has >= 2 words; a theme term only when it is >= min_meta_term_len characters and not generic. A key lives at most window_s after its decision. search_when_count_1h: the last-hour count that confirms a key and triggers its single search of search_max_results posts (author lookups: planner.search_max_authors).

planner._comment: Milestone 7: the confirmation planner. Keys come only from observe decisions (the mint, a non-generic $TICKER, the exact multi-word name) and from at most max_meta_keys of the strongest bursting themes (observe_meta decisions ranked by sol_inflow, unique_buyers), in a hard order: youngest coin observations first, themes after; at most max_active_keys at once (a higher-ranked candidate displaces the lowest active key, stop reason displaced). Counts every fast_interval_s during the first fast_phase_s after the decision, then every slow_interval_s, at most max_counts_per_key counts and max_searches_per_key searches per key. A key stops as soon as it is decided: confirmed (last-hour count >= confirm.search_when_count_1h) after exactly one search of confirm.search_max_results posts plus a user lookup of at most search_max_authors authors; refuted after refute_after_flat_counts consecutive counts without growth of the 24 h count; expired after confirm.window_s; graduated or dead (off the active watchlist); exhausted when max_counts_per_key is reached. full_load_keys_per_day and target_daily_cap_usd feed the full-load formula of `fart social dryrun` (docs/UNVERIFIED.md, 'X (Twitter) API v2'). Not a rule file.

dryrun._comment: Assumptions of `fart social dryrun` (no HTTP) while the tables have no history: posts per UTC day the mega query returns (elonmusk replies included) and the KOL batch returns; the share of planned keys that reach confirm.search_when_count_1h (confirmed_share) and the average number of counts a confirmed key needed (counts_per_confirmed_key); posts and distinct new authors per confirmation search (posts_per_search, authors_per_search; the ceilings are confirm.search_max_results and planner.search_max_authors). keys_per_day null = the observed admissions per day, else the eligible observations per day, else planner.full_load_keys_per_day. Once the daemon ran with a token, the command uses the observed rates of the last 7 days (social_posts, x_spend, x_keys) and says so ('observed rates'); replace these guesses by the observed figures in a commit (not a rule file).

fast_post._comment: A fast mega post whose rare words appear in >= min_coins pump.fun coin names created within window_s of the post by >= min_creators creators -> decisions kind fast_post (observation, no tier words). Milestone 6: in shadow mode the row goes to shadow_decisions (would_kind fast_post), never to decisions.
